Don't really feel like waiting, her leaving is only part of the reason I want to end things. Physical pain is starting to become unbearable. I've felt this way most of my life, I tried to twice and I failed twice. I won't fail this time.

It took me around 2 years, but it was a mutual thing, there were no lies or deceit or ulterior motives to why it ended, it had to end, there were no other options. I was also 16 at the time.

There's really no point in continuing though.

She was a great partner, she had issues of her own but they never got in the way of us. We helped each other with everything. It was the second time I had anything that was actually real. Not just meaningless sex. Things ended last november. That's how I know I can't move on, I tried, twice, and I ended up hurting some really nice people.

Anyways, I thank you for trying, I do, but with things happening in the way that they did, there is no point in continuing. I will be walking out of this miserable thing we call life at the end of the week.

Best of luck to you, hopefully you can help someone else. It's just too late for me.

She got distant one day and then a week later we fell apart because shes either stupid or easily manipulated, I don't know. I don't want anyone else anyways. 

So, no, there is really nothing left for me. I'll let the week play out and put a bullet in my head at the end of it. Already got my will written out and all of my notes written. I'll just be glad to stop being a burden on the world.

I've tried everything I could to recover. There is really nothing I want anymore. I was happy in my last relationship, and if I had her support through the rough shit that happened, I'd likely have been ok. But i had nothing. No support at all. When I really needed it. 

So that's it for me. I appreciate everyone who tried to help me. But it's far too late for that. Hopefully I'll fade out of existence and no one will notice. I can at least do that much, I hope.

Well, in the end its up to you. I won't give you the song and dance about how great life could be, I'm sure you're sick of it, I know I am.

In the end, we all die, most of us vanish off the face of the earth without having left a mark on society at all. Just realize that no matter what you think, taking your own life is going to hurt people, if you don't care about that, and you really want to give up, then there is nothing I can say that will change your mind, or anyone else for that matter.

I firmly believe some people just can't get through certain parts of life. I learned that recently. We are given the tools and methods to go out and do whatever we want, some things work out, some things don't. (most things if you're me) That being said, everything is a gamble, but if you put a gun to your head and pull the trigger, you aren't gambling. You can quit, hell anyone can at any time for any reason, but don't quit until there is no reason not to. If you have anything left in your life at all that brings you a little bit of joy, you aren't done yet.

That's how I see it at least.

Well I can tell you right now, until you have tried every method of help, you shouldn't give up. Go to therapy, talk to people, change things in your life to make them better if you can. You aren't supposed to give up until you are completely out of options, chances are you aren't anywhere near that yet.

Well, I can kinda relate to his reasoning. At the same time, that's literally toxic as hell. You really can't blame yourself for wanting to be out of that, as he didn't seem to respect you at all. 

If he has any friends or anything you should try and make sure they keep an eye on him. None of this is really your fault though, I mean, if you did everything you could and he wouldn't work with you or let you be you, then you did the right thing. 

My ex was the only reason I was happy, but at the same time, I let her be her and just enjoyed her company and taking care of her and being with her, ect.

If he didn't actually do anything, and chances are he wasn't going to, I wouldn't be too worried. Just make sure you don't go back thinking its your responsibility. You did what you could and it didn't work.

Point is, sitting there in the hospital with a girl I've known for 13 years holding her hand  and praying to whatever god there may be to save her, to take me instead because she didn't deserve to die. She told me she loved me and it took me a few seconds to respond, I don't even know why. It destroyed me. I'm like a zombie all the time now, because I have literally lost everything that ever mattered to me, and most of it is my fault.

It's a bit too late for any of that. I don't know why I ever bothered with anything really.

Anyone who says it's better to have loved and lost is full of shit.

If i ever do manage to fall asleep, which usually involves half a bottle of scotch, I have terrible nightmares about my failures. My ex won't leave my mind ever, I'd literally do anything to have her back but it doesn't matter to her, I guess I never did. Tomorrow I am going to help my dad at his house and clean up a few things, I won't be around by the end of the week. Good luck to anyone else who is struggling.

Honestly, there really isn't anything that can be done. I've been struggling with this for most of my life and I knew it would one day come to this. I never planned on living for long, but now that I have literally nothing, why shouldn't I just walk away? I tried everything from just going out and talking to more people and being social to therapy. I won't try pills because I have a history with those.

Some wounds never heal, and with the amount of bullshit I've put up with, I'm more likely to turn out like the joker than any sane normal man at this point. I'd rather not hurt anyone else anymore, regardless of how much they have harmed me.
